title: Why does my Autorun event stop all parallel events in the background

posts.author: Bwest09
posts.body:
I have a map set up with a lot of characters moving around on a custom route, set to parallel.
If I load up the map all Parallel events work as normal (without autorun enabled). But if I start editing a cutscene with text and stuff, set that to autorun so it starts at the beginning. All the Parallel events/characters stop moving. If I set the cutscene event to parallel instead of autorun everything works, but now the main character can move around, while the cutscene is supposed to be playing out. I feel like this is so simple that it should not be happening. I'm on MZ and have the main free Visustella plugins installed in correct order.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Why are they parallel instead of using custom autonomous move routes?
Have you tried the basic troubleshooting step of turning off your plugins? This is not how MZ works by default.

posts.author: Zahawk
posts.body: In VXAce the Show Text Command pauses all parrallel processes, there were scripts that fixed this. I'm just not sure if MZ also has that issue and if so, if someone has made a plugin to fix it.

posts.author: utunnels
posts.body: If you don't want your main character to move, you just give him a looping wait route during the cut scene.

posts.author: bgillisp
posts.body:
You should check the settings in that plugin. There is a setting that is stop all events while text is up, and it defaults to ON.
There's another to stop all events when another event is running too.
Reason these default to that is so a monster doesn't come up and say HI at an awkward time in game.
